Case: Patient D is a 52-year-old Hispanic woman who is post-op day 4 status-post L3-L4 laminectomy for lumbar stenosis. Surgery was uncomplicated, and she has met goals for discharge. Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
